screening_decisions.reason: This study compares two different patient decision aids (long vs short DA), not PROMs feedback vs no feedback. While surgeons received patient preference reports, the primary intervention is decision aids, not systematic PROMs feedback to healthcare providers. Does not meet selection criteria for PROMs feedback trials.

Randomized controlled trial comparing feedback of patient-reported anxiety scores (MDAS) to dentists vs no feedback. Measures patient outcomes (state anxiety). Directly compares PROMs feedback to healthcare professional with no feedback control group. Meets all selection criteria.

Randomized controlled trial investigating session-by-session progress feedback using Outcome Rating Scale (PROM) to therapists vs no feedback condition. Measures therapy outcomes. Directly compares PROMs feedback to healthcare professional with no feedback control. Meets selection criteria.

This study compares two feedback conditions (therapist+supervisor vs therapist alone) rather than feedback vs no feedback. Both intervention arms receive PROMs feedback; there is no control group without feedback. Does not meet selection criteria requiring comparison with 'not providing such information'.

This study evaluates patient self-monitoring via eHealth application with feedback primarily to patients themselves, not systematic PROMs feedback to healthcare providers. The control group receives delayed access rather than no feedback. Does not directly compare PROMs feedback to healthcare professionals vs no feedback.
This is an integrated literature review examining graphical display principles, not a randomized trial comparing PROMs feedback vs no feedback.

Randomized controlled trial with mobile telehealth intervention including graphical and nurse-initiated feedback on patient-reported data vs standard care. Measures clinical and patient-reported outcomes. Meets selection criteria for PROMs feedback RCT.

RCT comparing regular HRQL assessment with feedback to physicians vs no feedback vs control (no HRQL measurement). Directly compares PROMs feedback to healthcare professionals with no feedback. Measures outcomes and processes of care. Meets selection criteria.

RCT comparing feedback of depression screening results (Zung scale) to physicians vs no feedback. Directly compares PROMs feedback to healthcare professionals with no feedback control. Measures recognition and treatment outcomes. Meets selection criteria.
